literal: Fifth month, summered for coolness at Coal Mountain.
idiomatic: In the fifth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

literal: Sixth month, on wuwu day Kedun City was made Zhen Prefecture and its army called Jian'an.
idiomatic: On wuwu day of the sixth month Kedun City was made Zhen Prefecture and its garrison named Jian'an Army.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiashen day envoys were dispatched to invest Li Dezhao of Western Xia as King of Xiping.
idiomatic: On jiashen day of the seventh autumn month envoys were sent to invest Li Dezhao of Western Xia as King of Xiping.

literal: On dinghai day the Wunai, Punuli, Po'ali, Yuelidu, Aolimi, and other tribes came with tribute.
idiomatic: On dinghai day the Wunai, Punuli, Po'ali, Yuelidu, Aolimi, and other tribes came with tribute.

literal: Eighth month, on bingchen day the Tangut came with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingchen day of the eighth month the Tangut came with tribute.

literal: On gengshen day Zubu chief Tielili came to court.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Zubu chief Tielili came to court.

literal: On wuchen day Tielili requested marriage; it was not granted.
idiomatic: On wuchen day Tielili requested marriage, and the request was refused.

literal: On bingzi day the court halted at Quanya Mountain.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the court halted at Quanya Mountain.

literal: Ninth month, on jichou day Goryeo was notified of the southern campaign.
idiomatic: On jichou day of the ninth month Goryeo was notified of the southern campaign.

literal: On bingwu day the court visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: On bingwu day the court visited Nanjing.

literal: The Jurchen sent envoys presenting the wife and children of Wu Zhaoqing, whom they had captured.
idiomatic: The Jurchen sent envoys presenting the wife and children of the captured Wu Zhaoqing.

literal: On dingwei day sacrifice was performed at Emperor Taizong's temple.
idiomatic: On dingwei day sacrifice was performed at Emperor Taizong's temple.

literal: Northern Court Great King Malugu and Grand Commandant Laojunnu were put in charge of the Northern and Southern Princely House troops.
idiomatic: Northern Court Great King Malugu and Grand Commandant Laojunnu were put in charge of the Northern and Southern Princely House troops.

literal: On gengxu day King of Chu Longyou was ordered to remain at the capital.
idiomatic: On gengxu day King of Chu Longyou was ordered to remain at the capital.

literal: Intercalary month, on jiwei day the southern campaign began.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the intercalary month the southern campaign began.

literal: On guihai day the court halted at Gu'an.
idiomatic: On guihai day the court halted at Gu'an.

literal: A captured spy was used to shoot ghost arrows.
idiomatic: A captured spy was used in the ghost-arrow rite.

literal: On jiazi day black ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On jiazi day black ox and white horse were sacrificed to heaven and earth.

literal: On bingyin day the Liao army fought Song forces at Tangxing and inflicted a great defeat.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the Liao army fought Song forces at Tangxing and inflicted a great defeat.

literal: On dingmao day Xiao Talin fought the Song army at Suicheng and defeated it.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Xiao Talin fought the Song army at Suicheng and defeated it.

literal: On gengwu day the army encamped at Wangdu.
idiomatic: On gengwu day the army encamped at Wangdu.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on yiyou day black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the tenth winter month black and white sheep were sacrificed to heaven and earth.

literal: On bingxu day Ying Prefecture was attacked but not taken.
idiomatic: On bingxu day Ying Prefecture was attacked but not taken.

literal: On jiawu day Qizhou was taken, and surrendering troops were rewarded with wine and dried meat.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Qizhou was taken, and surrendering troops were rewarded with wine and dried meat.

literal: Sacrifice was performed to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: Sacrifice was performed to heaven and earth.

literal: On jiyou day King of Xiping Li Dezhao sent envoys thanking the court for the investiture.
idiomatic: On jiyou day King of Xiping Li Dezhao sent envoys thanking the court for the investiture.

literal: Eleventh month, on guihai day cavalry commander Yelü Keli encountered Song forces at Ming Prefecture and repelled them.
idiomatic: On guihai day of the eleventh month cavalry commander Yelü Keli encountered Song forces at Ming Prefecture and repelled them.

literal: On jiazi day Eastern Capital regent Xiao Paiya captured Song officials of Wei prefecture Tian Fengji, Guo Shourong, Chang Xian, Liu Chuo, and others and presented them.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Eastern Capital regent Xiao Paiya captured Song officials of Wei prefecture Tian Fengji, Guo Shourong, Chang Xian, Liu Chuo, and others and presented them.

literal: On dingmao day Southern Court Great King Shanbu reported that Song had sent bows and arrows to Wang Jizhong and secretly requested peace.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Southern Court Great King Shanbu reported that Song had sent bows and arrows to Wang Jizhong and secretly requested peace.

literal: An edict ordered Wang Jizhong to meet the envoy, and peace was granted.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Wang Jizhong to meet the envoy, and peace was granted.

literal: On gengwu day Deqing Army was captured.
idiomatic: On gengwu day Deqing Army was captured.

literal: On renshen day the court halted at Chanyuan.
idiomatic: On renshen day the court halted at Chanyuan.

literal: Xiao Talin was struck by a hidden crossbow bolt and died.
idiomatic: Xiao Talin was struck by a hidden crossbow bolt and died.

literal: On yihai day Tongli Army was captured.
idiomatic: On yihai day Tongli Army was captured.

literal: On dingchou day Song sent Vice Commissioner for Court Ceremonies Cao Liyong seeking peace, and the Flying Dragon Commissioner Han Qi was immediately dispatched with a letter in reply.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Song sent Vice Commissioner for Court Ceremonies Cao Liyong seeking peace, and the Flying Dragon Commissioner Han Qi was immediately sent with a letter in reply.

literal: Twelfth month, on the gengchen new moon there was a total solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the twelfth month there was a total solar eclipse.

literal: On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Shuzhi was dispatched with a letter in reply.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Song again sent Cao Liyong, and because there was no intention to return territory, Supervisory Gate Guard General Yao Shuzhi was sent with a letter in reply.

idiomatic: On wuzi day Song sent Li Jichang seeking peace, addressing the Empress Dowager as aunt and offering yearly payment of one hundred thousand taels of silver and two hundred thousand bolts of silk.

literal: Peace was granted, and Gate Commissioner Ding Zhen was immediately dispatched with a letter in reply.
idiomatic: Peace was granted, and Gate Commissioner Ding Zhen was immediately sent with a letter in reply.

literal: On jichou day an edict ordered all armies to stand down.
idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered all armies to stand down.

literal: That month the army withdrew.
idiomatic: That month the army withdrew.

literal: The Empress Dowager granted Grand Chancellor King of Qi Han Dechang the surname Yelü and transferred him to King of Jin.
idiomatic: The Empress Dowager granted Grand Chancellor King of Qi Han Dechang the surname Yelü and transferred him to King of Jin.

literal: That year jinshi Li Kefeng and three others were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year jinshi Li Kefeng and three others passed the examinations.

literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, on wuwu day the court returned and halted at Nanjing.
idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, on wuwu day of the first spring month, the court returned and halted at Nanjing.

literal: On gengshen day a great feast was held for generals and soldiers, and ranks and rewards were granted in varying measure.
idiomatic: On gengshen day a great feast was held for generals and soldiers, and ranks and rewards were granted in varying measure.

literal: Second month, on bingxu day the border market at Zhenwu Army was restored.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the second month the border market at Zhenwu Army was restored.

literal: On dingsi day Western Xia sent envoys reporting the capture of Song's Qingcheng.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Western Xia sent envoys reporting the capture of Song's Qingcheng.

literal: On xinyou day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On xinyou day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.

literal: Tiyin Huage was made Southern Court Great King, and mobile army supervisor Laojunnu was made tiyin.
idiomatic: Tiyin Huage was appointed Southern Court Great King, and mobile army supervisor Laojunnu was appointed tiyin.

literal: On yichou day the Tangut tribes were pacified.
idiomatic: On yichou day the Tangut tribes were pacified.

literal: On dingmao day the Uyghur came with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the Uyghur came with tribute.

idiomatic: On dingchou day the Feihu recruitment-and-pacification commissioner of Yi Prefecture was changed to pacification commissioner.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingxu day the Jurchen and Arsalan Uyghur each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingxu day of the fourth summer month the Jurchen and Arsalan Uyghur each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On yiwei day the Iron Li came with tribute.
idiomatic: On yiwei day the Iron Li came with tribute.

literal: On jihai day the Tangut invaded.
idiomatic: On jihai day the Tangut invaded.

literal: Fifth month, on the wushen new moon Song sent Sun Jin and others to congratulate the Empress Dowager's birthday.
idiomatic: On the wushen new moon of the fifth month Song sent Sun Jin and others to congratulate the Empress Dowager's birthday.

literal: On yimao day gold and silk were granted to the families of soldiers killed in battle.
idiomatic: On yimao day gold and silk were granted to the families of soldiers killed in battle.

literal: On bingyin day Goryeo, because of peace with Song, sent envoys to offer congratulations.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Goryeo, because of peace with Song, sent envoys to offer congratulations.

literal: Sixth month, on renchen day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the sixth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

literal: On jiawu day Zubu chief Tielili sent envoys congratulating the peace with Song.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Zubu chief Tielili sent envoys congratulating the peace with Song.

literal: On jihai day the nine tribes of Dadan state sent envoys on a friendly visit.
idiomatic: On jihai day the nine tribes of Dadan state sent envoys on a friendly visit.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guichou day the court inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
idiomatic: On guichou day of the seventh autumn month the court inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

literal: On wuwu day the Tangut came with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuwu day the Tangut came with tribute.

literal: On xinyou day black ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
idiomatic: On xinyou day black ox and white horse were sacrificed to heaven and earth.

literal: On renxu day the Ugu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On renxu day the Ugu came with tribute.

literal: On dingmao day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys requesting the release of previously detained envoys; all were sent off.
idiomatic: Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys requesting the release of previously detained envoys, and all were sent off.

literal: Ninth month, on jiaxu day Grand Commandant Ali and Grand Tutor Yang Liu were dispatched to congratulate the Song emperor's birthday.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the ninth month Grand Commandant Ali and Grand Tutor Yang Liu were sent to congratulate the Song emperor's birthday.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on the bingzi new moon the Bigud came with tribute.
idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon of the tenth winter month the Bigud came with tribute.

literal: On wuzi day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.
idiomatic: On wuzi day the court had audience with the Empress Dowager.

literal: On jiawu day the court halted at Qidu River.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the court halted at Qidu River.

literal: On guimao day Song's yearly tribute first arrived; afterward it became regular.
idiomatic: On guimao day Song's yearly tribute first arrived; afterward it became regular.

literal: Eleventh month, on wushen day the Emperor dispatched Grand Preceptor Hezhu and distribution commissioner Han Song, and the Empress Dowager dispatched Grand Preceptor Pannu and Secretariat drafter Gao Zheng to Song to congratulate the New Year.
idiomatic: On wushen day of the eleventh month the Emperor sent Grand Preceptor Hezhu and distribution commissioner Han Song, and the Empress Dowager sent Grand Preceptor Pannu and Secretariat drafter Gao Zheng to Song to congratulate the New Year.

literal: On xinhai day the court watched fishing on the Sanggan River.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the court watched fishing on the Sanggan River.

literal: On dingsi day an edict ordered Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang removed from the palace household registry and affiliated with the Horizontal Tents.
idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang removed from the palace household registry and affiliated with the Horizontal Tents.

literal: Twelfth month, on bingshen day Song sent Zhou Jian and others to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the twelfth month Song sent Zhou Jian and others to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: On dingyou day Song again sent Zhang Ruogu and others to congratulate the New Year.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Song again sent Zhang Ruogu and others to congratulate the New Year.

literal: In the twenty-fourth year, spring, first month, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, in the first spring month, the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: Summer, fifth month, on the renyin new moon the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the fifth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

idiomatic: Imperial Consort Hu of You was buried alive at Huaizhou, Lady Yilan was imprisoned at Nanjing, and all remaining conspirators were buried alive.

idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the seventh autumn month the court made a southern tour.

idiomatic: On bingxu day of the eighth month Nanjing Palace's Xuanjiao Gate was renamed Yuanhe, the outer three gates Nanduan, the left side gate Wanchun, and the right side gate Qianqiu.

idiomatic: That month Shazhou Dunhuang King Cao Shou sent envoys presenting Arabian horses and fine jade, and paired robes, silver vessels, and other items were granted in return.

literal: Ninth month, the court visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the court visited Nanjing.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on the gengwu new moon the Emperor led the officials in bestowing on the Empress Dowager the honorific Sage Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive Fortune, Initiating Transformation, and Sustaining Heaven Empress Dowager, and the officials bestowed on the Emperor the honorific Utmost Virtue, Broad Filiality, Illustrious Sagacity, Heaven-Assisted Emperor.
idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the tenth winter month the Emperor led the officials in bestowing on the Empress Dowager the honorific Sage Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive Fortune, Initiating Transformation, and Sustaining Heaven Empress Dowager, and the officials bestowed on the Emperor the honorific Utmost Virtue, Broad Filiality, Illustrious Sagacity, Heaven-Assisted Emperor.

idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

idiomatic: That year jinshi Yang Ji and twenty-three others passed the examinations.

idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, in the first spring month, the Central Capital was built.

idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: Summer, fourth month, the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

idiomatic: In the sixth month Imperial Consort Hu was granted death at her place of confinement.

idiomatic: On renshen day of the seventh autumn month the mother of King of Xiping Li Dezhao died, and envoys were sent to mourn and sacrifice.

idiomatic: On jiaxu day envoys were sent to recall him from mourning.

idiomatic: In the ninth month Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu attacked the Zubu and defeated them.

idiomatic: On bingshen day of the tenth winter month the court halted at the Central Capital.

idiomatic: On yiyou day of the twelfth month famine victims of Raozhou were relieved.
